name: Nerien'eth

hardmode_info: The hard mode requirement requires 4 wraiths to be alive when the boss picks up the sword at 35% health.

related_quests: Edge of Darkness: Release the Crypt of Hearts from Mephala's grip.
Pledge: Crypt of Hearts II: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the Crypt of Hearts II.
summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Nerien'eth (set). Nerien'eth is a High Elf lich found inside the Crypt of Hearts II. The chamber he is in contains the Ebony Blade and is accessed from a portal guarded by Mezeluth. He has a chance to drop Nerien'eth's Forsaken Staff.
